review_candidates.description: Company Description Nexcope Private Limited is a space technology startup focused on developing highly reliable, algorithm-driven compression solutions for satellites, drones, and surveillance systems. The company is advancing cutting-edge data compression to improve efficiency and performance in demanding aerospace and defense environments. Nexcope has achieved Technology Readiness Level 4 for its satellite segment solutions and Technology Readiness Level 7 for its drone applications, demonstrating strong progress toward deployment. Team members can expect to work on innovative products with practical applications in emerging space and aerial technologies. Role Description The Embedded System Engineer will design, develop, and test embedded software and hardware solutions that support Nexcope’s advanced compression technologies. Daily responsibilities include writing and optimizing code for embedded platforms, integrating sensors and communication modules, troubleshooting system-level issues, and collaborating with cross-functional teams on product design and validation. The engineer will participate in prototyping, hardware bring-up, performance tuning, and documentation of designs, tests, and processes. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bhopal, requiring close collaboration with engineering and product teams to deliver robust, production-ready systems. Qualifications Strong embedded software skills, including Embedded Software development and general Software Development for microcontrollers and real-time systems. Solid foundation in Electronics and Electrical Engineering for embedded hardware interfaces, circuit analysis, and system integration. Experience with Internet of Things (IoT) applications, including sensor integration, connectivity protocols, and edge devices. Proficiency with C/C++ or similar languages, firmware development tools, and debugging on embedded platforms. Familiarity with communication protocols (e.g., SPI, I2C, UART, CAN) and basic RF or wireless technologies is beneficial. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Ability to read and interpret schematics, work with lab equipment (oscilloscope, logic analyzer), and perform hardware debugging. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work collaboratively in an on-site startup environment.
